In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] '''security officer''' ordered the destruction of a [[Dorsk 82's starship|starship]] used by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Dorsk 82]] in an attempt to rescue a number of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] from a mob on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. He later attempted to capture Dorsk 82 to turn him over to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], but the Jedi [[Death/Legends|was killed]] in the ensuing altercation.
